objective: Make committee AI routing resilient to timeouts and unavailable providers without fabricating votes or changing production behavior.
current_behavior: Providers can timeout or return malformed reviews.
Unavailable providers are preserved as errors but routing is manual.
Missing votes correctly do not count as approval.
bounded_design: Quorum computed only from valid completed verdicts.
Research-only output with false production safety flags.
acceptance_tests: Timeout is recorded and never treated as approval.
Malformed review is recorded as error.
Quorum excludes unavailable, skipped, and errored providers.
